signal: indirect diffuse reflected radiance, raw or actual custom filtered explicitly separated

thin_wall.fixture: existing LightingValidation thin-walls, closed10mm separator with left emissive panel; physical indirect around front opening is allowed by oracle
thin_wall.pixel_masks: independent primary ray/triangle intersections, opaque non-emitter surfaces; erode each primary surface label and each geometric bright/dark mask by2px; no intensity or candidate-dependent ROI selection
thin_wall.bright_control: primary floor/back/left-wall surfaces with WORLD x<-0.1,z<-0.1; segment to emitter centre unoccluded
thin_wall.dark_behind_wall: primary floor/back/right-wall/right face of thin separator with WORLD x>=0.004,z<-0.1; segment to emitter centre first blocked by the known10mm separator
thin_wall.missing_coverage: fail coverage, do not expand regions after seeing candidate; no leakage acceptance
thin_wall.requirements: finite nonnegative candidate; root must also execute a distance-moment-disabled physical negative when available, whose leak predicate must fail; state-checker failure alone is not the quality negative

recovery.fixture: emissive-step: exact Cornell geometry/camera/materials except unique emitter Le12 through frame255, Le6 from frame256 onward; update is called before frame0; dt0 setup/pause does not count
recovery.reference_before: validated Cornell unlimited-minus-direct reference already frozen
recovery.reference_after: exact0.5*reference_before ONLY after snapshot comparison proves unchanged physical scene/camera and all emission scaled0.5, with no other light/sky
recovery.regions: same frozen Cornell six eroded geometry ROIs; no crop or threshold change
recovery.static_quality: at+128 require same20% bias /30% NRMSE against physical reference_after; report instantaneous each checkpoint and fixed trailing8frame mean once available
recovery.history_residual: perROI absolute(mean_luminance(candidate_checkpoint)-0.5*mean_luminance(candidate_pretransition_mean))/(0.5*mean_luminance(candidate_pretransition_mean)) <=0.10 at+128; this separates old-state retention from stationary approximation bias, while physical static gates remain mandatory
recovery.history_residual_scale_floor: pretransition mean must exceed1e-6 and its physical static gates must pass; otherwise recovery is inconclusive, never PASS
recovery.report: first sampled passing checkpoint and every0/1/4/8/16/32/64/128 value, plus whether it remains passing at all later sampled checkpoints; no report of only the128 checkbox
recovery.f13_separate_gate: F13 history rejection <=4frames is independent and NOT certified by F12 convergence<=128; report+1/+4 images and history diagnostics separately
recovery.negative_controls: retained pretransition image and allzero posttransition image must fail both physical endpoint and history-residual predicates
recovery.endpoint_gate: At+128 both instantaneous image and trailing8frame mean must pass physical quality and history residual; the latter does not replace the instantaneous requirement.

failure_policy: preserve previous raw and filtered failures; no new threshold or ROI chosen from candidate pixels; no phase acceptance from one fixture
